name: tr_slowmo
caption:
IF KYLE ANDERSON HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🐌 Slowpoke: incredibly slow, never worries about the time. His nickname since 8th grade, for his deliberate pace
🪄 Alakazam: makes its spoons with psychic power. His high school coach called him a modern-day Magic Johnson
🐉 Hydreigon: three heads that devour everything in its path. 13 points, 12 rebounds, 11 assists in one UCLA game
🐱 Meowth: sneaks out at night and hoards every coin it finds. 6 steals in one playoff game, a Memphis record
🌊 Lapras: ferries people across the sea on its back. 7 franchises counting us, plus China at the 2023 World Cup
👑 Slowking: incredible intellect, calm in any situation. A 6-9 point guard with a 7-3 wingspan, now ours

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Kyle Anderson had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF SLOW-MO HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Slowpoke. Incredibly slow, and never worried about the time. He plays so deliberately, he's been Slow-Mo since eighth grade.
beats.dlg: NEVER WORRIES ABOUT TIME.|SLOW-MO SINCE GRADE 8.

beats.vo: Alakazam. It makes its spoons with psychic power. His high school coach called him a modern-day Magic Johnson.
beats.dlg: SPOONS MADE BY ITS MIND.|A MODERN-DAY MAGIC JOHNSON

beats.vo: Hydreigon. Three heads, and it uses all three to devour everything. At UCLA: thirteen points, twelve rebounds, eleven assists in one night.
beats.dlg: THREE HEADS, DEVOURS ALL.|13 PTS, 12 REB, 11 AST!

beats.vo: Meowth. It sneaks around at night, picking up every coin it finds. Six steals in one playoff game, a Memphis franchise record.
beats.dlg: IT PICKS UP EVERY COIN.|6 PLAYOFF STEALS, A RECORD

beats.vo: Lapras. It ferries people across the sea on its back. Seven franchises counting us, and the World Cup with China's national team.
beats.dlg: IT FERRIES PEOPLE BY SEA.|7 TEAMS AND TEAM CHINA!

beats.vo: And the ace. Slowking. Incredible intellect, calm in any situation. Six-nine, a seven-three wingspan, running the point. Now he's ours.
beats.dlg: CALM, COLLECTED, A GENIUS.|6-9, 7-3 WINGSPAN, OURS!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Anderson nicknamed Slow Mo after his deliberate style, a nickname earned in eighth (8th) grade in AAU; high school coach Bob Hurley: 'I think he's a modern-day Magic Johnson'; November 22, 2013 at UCLA: 13 points, 12 rebounds, 11 assists (triple-double) vs Morehead State; 2021 playoff opener at Utah: Memphis franchise single-game playoff record six (6) steals; franchises: Spurs, Grizzlies, Timberwolves, Warriors, Heat, Jazz, Raptors (7); Chinese citizenship, played for China at the 2023 FIBA World Cup; standing 6 feet 9 inches (6-9) with a 7 feet 3 inches (7-3) wingspan, ran the offense as point guard; 2014 NBA draft 30th overall pick (#30)
